description: This Java class 'PEMToFile' provides utility methods for converting, reading, and handling PEM-encoded certificates and private keys, including file reading, encoding, decoding, and certificate validation.

classes.name: PEMToFile
classes.description: Utility class for handling PEM-encoded certificates and private keys, including conversion, reading from files, and validation.

methods.name: privateKeyToPEM
methods.description: Converts a PrivateKey object to its PEM string representation based on algorithm.

methods.name: certToPEM
methods.description: Converts one or more X509Certificates to PEM format string.

methods.name: toPEM
methods.description: Helper method to encode byte array to PEM format with specified begin and end markers.

methods.name: privateKeyBytesFromPEM
methods.description: Decodes PEM string to byte array of the private key.

methods.name: keySpecFromPEM
methods.description: Creates a KeySpec object from PEM string.

methods.name: privateKeyFromPEMFile
methods.description: Reads a private key from a PEM file.

methods.name: privateKeyFromPEM
methods.description: Parses a PEM string to extract a PrivateKey object.

methods.name: x509FromPEMFile
methods.description: Reads an X509Certificate from a PEM file.

methods.name: x509FromPEM
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate from a PEM string.

methods.name: x509ChainFromPEMFile
methods.description: Reads a chain of X509Certificates from a PEM file.

methods.name: x509ChainFromPEM
methods.description: Creates a list of X509Certificates from a PEM string.

methods.name: validX509PEMFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a valid X509 PEM file exists at the specified path.
